description: Reference snapshot (NOT a pipeline input): GitHub repos with >= min_stars that FAIL scope_filter — the rules already classify them as outside the Claude Code ecosystem, so they never reach repos.json or the denylist. Stored for audit transparency (the full >=min_stars universe = repos.json + out_of_scope.json + this list) and to spot a metadata-blind ecosystem repo (cf. openclaw) wrongly excluded here. Snapshot, stale-prone; regenerate via helpers/coverage_sweep.py.
